services.title: Tree removal
services.body: Where there is room, the tree comes down in one piece; where there is not, it comes down in sections on ropes.
services.alt: A trunk section held on the grapple and swung clear of the roof below

evidence.text: A wide trunk taken down to a clean flat cut at ground level

services.title: Stump grinding and removal
services.body: The stump is ground below grade and the chips are raked out or hauled, so the ground is usable again.
services.alt: The crane boom reaching over the roofline to take a limb out between two houses

evidence.text: One of the crew cutting down the last of the stump at the kerb with the saw

services.title: Storm damage and emergency removal
services.body: When a tree has come down on a roof or a deck, the first job is getting the weight off safely.
services.alt: A long trunk section held out on the boom and lowered down clear of the wires

evidence.text: One of the crew stood in at the storm job where the tree came down onto the house

services.title: Climbing and sectional dismantling

reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Don Ross
reviews.text: JPX - 5 stars! Everyone was polite, prompt, and professional. AJ and his crew were very careful and precise with a broken limb and trimming trees near my house. They have the equipment! A remote controlled bucket truck that looked like it was from a Transformers movie. The crew worked as a unit to get the job done right. They removed all the branches and cleaned up completely. Great communication with the owner discussing the scope of the job, and with the staff - she was very responsive with scheduling. Highly recommend. Thank you, JPX

reviews.author: warren
reviews.text: I recently had a chance to see their work clearing a lot for a new home next to my house. Having been in the home construction for many years I have seen many a lots cleared. Their work was probably one of the best I’ve ever seen. I hired them to remove a few trees from my lot and they did an excellent job from removal to cleanup. I was very satisfied with the work and the price. I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Barry Clark
reviews.text: Finally a contractor that delivers.12 trees had to be removed successfully in 1 day.Extremely hard working crew and polite on top of it all.

reviews.author: Brad S
reviews.text: JPX put in a long, hot 90° day removing all my trees. Even though there was a communication problem (probably me) we quickly fixed it, and like everything else, it was done perfectly. Handful of guys moving with precision all day. Little wasted motion. Everyone knows their job. Equipment is incredible and watching it all was a highlight. I can't possibly recommend them more than saying I'm having them back to excavate my property too.

reviews.author: Jamie Silva
reviews.text: JPX was terrific to work with and I highly recommend them! The price, professionalism, and service was outstanding. Very knowledgeable and cleaned up everything like you didn’t even know they were there. Happy to recommend this company to anyone looking for great work at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Christine Kile
reviews.text: From the estimate to the finalized project, JPX was a pleasure to work with. Their responses were timely and their work was very careful, protecting the property while getting the work done. Even went above and beyond to rake and level an area they knew will be turned into a flower bed. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: John E Roche
reviews.text: Jerod made this project a priority due to my landscapers schedule. His workers showed up on time and worked with me on my concerns with the cleanup in the flower beds. His workers were polite and hard working. I would definitely recommend this service to friends and family and would use again if needed.

reviews.author: Arthur Kwok
reviews.text: After researching and obtaining quotes from 8 different local tree services, I'm glad I settled on Jared and JPX because they did an incredible job. I had multiple trees removed, stumps grinded, the ground cleaned, root raked, and forestry mulched on 3000 sq ft of dense brush and trees to extend my back yard - and they did it professionally, quickly, and with attention to detail. Their crew was efficient and professional. They brought in multiple pieces of equipment that got the job done properly. Despite the heavy equipment, they laid mats carefully to protect my existing lawn - and when they left - there was no damage whatsoever. I can say that JPX was less than half the price than some of their competitors, including my neighbor who, using a different company, paid more than us. However, the quality of work by JPX was immeasurably better. In this case, you get much more than what you pay for. If you are in EHT or the surrounding area, look no further. JPX offers the right price for quality work. You will not regret it. Thank you to Jared and your crew!

reviews.author: Claude Jordan
reviews.text: JPX is a Class act. the whole crew is very professional and courteous, and they have all of the right/amazing equipment to do the job quickly and safely and the pricing is very fair. I have been a builder for 35 + years and I'm always careful about who I recommend to clients because it puts my name on the line also, but I would recommend them to anyone without reservations. Thank you guys again.

reviews.author: Violet Foster
reviews.text: JPX Tree Service went above and beyond! They were professional, timely, and neat. Very happy with their service! I would defenetly recommend them to anyone looking for a quality tree cutting and removal company.

reviews.author: Shane Siragusa
reviews.text: Jared and his crew did an awesome job of removing 14 extra large trees from my property. Watching them really showed that it truly is an art and takes a team to execute with the precision that they did. I want to thank you again for a job well done and my wife and I couldn’t be happier.

reviews.author: Donald Brown
reviews.text: Jared and Becca were very responsive from initial phone call for service to the prompt execution of the estimate to the scheduling of the Tree Work . Work was executed in a very professional manor using the latest in tree equipment with safety in mind. Ownership followed up upon completion of job and made a site visit. A final bill was presented as quoted . I would highly recommend JPX Tree service for any of your Tree Work , Land Clearing and Grading Work 10 out of 10 !

reviews.author: John Castagna
reviews.text: Absolutely Professional in every way ! Every employee knew their role like a finely tuned symphony, they live up to their reviews ! Very Fair Pricing, safely, no damage and good cleanup .

reviews.author: Jerry Herriott
reviews.text: On 10/9/2025 Had JPX remove a very large oak tree in Northfield. They did an outstanding job as usual. The company is so professional and they have the best equipment.I have used them many times and always GREAT. Definitely the best tree service company you could find.

reviews.author: Nick Olson
reviews.text: JPX Tree Service goes above and beyond for their customers. Attention to detail, top of the line industry equipment, and safety when it counts the most. I trust this group for all of my tree needs around my home. AJ just finished grinding a bunch of stumps on my property. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Mike Germanio
reviews.text: We were referred to JPX by the owner's step-dad. We had gotten a few other estimates but were completely ghosted by the other companies. They would give us an estimate and then never respond again. I messaged JPX on a Saturday, they gave us our estimate that Tuesday, and were removing the tree the Wednesday of the following week. The price was the same as the other companies and most importantly the woman in the office was super helpful and very responsive. We couldn't be happier with everything. We look forward to not only using JPX again but referring them to others in the future.

reviews.author: Jonathon Flegel
reviews.text: I would not recommend JPX Tree Service based on their poor communication and lack of care for neighboring property. During a lot clearing behind my home, they cleared a part of my property and took out my metal survey stake. I called to kindly explain the situation, but the office staff was dismissive and unprofessional. Instead of offering a solution, the woman I spoke with told me I was wrong and that there was "nothing they would do." They eventually passed the buck to the builder. Save yourself the headache and hire a company that actually stands by their work.

reviews.author: James T
reviews.text: Jared, Matt, and their team are a group of hard working tree surgeons with outstanding work ethic! They exceeded our expectations by efficiently removing ten large trees from our yard at a more competitive price than other local tree services. I highly recommend JPX Tree Service and am very satisfied.

reviews.author: Train 4 Sora LLC
reviews.text: A Family run company. Quickly responsive to quote request and scheduling the job on my property. Crew was professional and cleaned everything up afterwards. Very satisfied with overall project.

reviews.author: Susan Schmitz
reviews.text: I used JPX tree service to remove a couple trees and prune a big oak tree in my backyard. They did a great job! They were very Professional, neat and polite. They are hard workers and didn’t stop till the job was complete. I would definitely recommend them they are worth more than five stars that’s for sure. Thanks again Jared and the crew!

reviews.author: joe taylor
reviews.text: Just wanted to reach out to JPX and say thank you for a job well done! This was a 5 foot tree that was meant to be tackled by this crew. The guy on the crane was so smooth it made me feel safe to have him there. The ground crew was awesome as well it looked like they vacuumed the grass I was so happy. Thanks again I’ll be calling you for the one out back!

reviews.author: Christine Schrum
reviews.text: Great job and affordable. I had compliments how well the cleaned up the area. Very friendly and knowledgeable. Would definitely use them again. Excellent service

reviews.author: Jennifer Cugini
reviews.text: The guys were here on time and spent a couple hours trimming very big trees. They cleaned everything up and did an amazing job!

reviews.author: Gianna Torres
reviews.text: Today I met Jared from JPX as he drove this enormous crane onto my property to off load a Swimspa from a flatbed to my backyard. Jared was called by Justin and Matt from “All Dirty Deeds..” (who I’ve used before and love their work) because although they could use a forklift , the damage to my backyard would be significant and they felt Jared could get the job done faster and easier. They were absolutely right. Jared was amazing at guiding that crane. It was amazing to watch and there was no damage to my property . All this was planned in less than 12 hours and expertly executed by these men. Very professional, pleasant and hardworking people. Thank you Jared I know this was very last minute and I will definitely use your company again.

reviews.author: Alan Lands
reviews.text: From the initial estimate from Matt to the tree trimming these guys were excellent. Very personable and professional. The aerial equipment was state of the art and allowed the men to reach the highest branches. The finished product was better than I expected. Price was very fair and reasonable. Highly recommend JPX.

reviews.author: Patrick Campbell
reviews.text: I’ve used Matt and team’s services on three occasions over the past couple of years, and their work is outstanding! Consistently reliable, professional, quality work each time starting with Becca in scheduling and followed through by Matt and team. I highly recommend JPX Tree Service for anyone’s tree removal, grinding, or pruning needs!

reviews.author: Funny Farm Rescue & Sanctuary
reviews.text: Jared and his amazing crew saved our 2500lb famous cow “Yogi” from being stuck in the mud. It was a national news story. He was like an angel and the nicest people you ever want to meet. They don’t mess around. They know how to get the most difficult jobs done. They are family and we love them and their company to pieces. We will never forget what they did for us and they asked for nothing in return. They give back to their community and they love animals. Thank you Jared!

reviews.author: Todd Timbrook
reviews.text: These guys are amazing. Very professional and clean up meticulously after the job. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Linda Rose
reviews.text: Extremely happy with removal of tree branches and trimming of several trees. Jared is knowledgeable and thoroughly explained the proper time to trim the trees. We found him, Matt, and the team to be professional and courteous. Would recommend them.

reviews.author: Immanuel Palugod
reviews.text: Jared and his team did a great job. Clearly explained to me how to prepare for the site clearing, outlined any issues that may come up (none did), and was flexible and friendly when they did the job. I requested Jared to do more work the day of until the sun went down since I was so pleased with the work. He got a lot done that I didn’t expect to be in scope and it looks great. Expect to have a long relationship with JPX and will happily refer him to anyone.

reviews.author: Jennifer Handson
reviews.text: Excellent Service! Did a fantastic job taking down the broken trees from the winter storms and thoroughly cleaning up afterwards. Thank you!

reviews.author: Frank Florence
reviews.text: JPX did an AMAZING job removing a large dead oak from my backyard. Matt and his crew were professional and friendly, leaving my property in better shape than before the work began. The whole process was seamless and quick. I requested the estimate via the website on a Tuesday, Matt came that evening, and the work was done by Thursday afternoon. I will be recommending JPX to anyone in need of tree service!

reviews.author: John DeAnnuntis
reviews.text: Jared came right out promptly. We walked the property and he was very knowledgeable about my trees. I had a quote within the hour, and his the company showed up and did an excellent job! I would highly recommend them. John D

reviews.author: debbie sarno
reviews.text: Amazing from start to finish. Competitive pricing too!!! Highly recommend if you’re in the need for tree. Professionals!!!!

reviews.author: tom poponak
reviews.text: Awesome experience….showed up on time did the work promised and for the price quoted…. I would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Aaron Sykes
reviews.text: Only great things to say about JPX Tree Service. Their prices are right on point and they are quick to respond. I could not recommend them more for any tree work that you need!!

reviews.author: Caitlin Rochford
reviews.text: Jared and his guys from JPX were amazing!!!! Timely and efficient and the price was great for the amount of work they did especially in the freezing cold. I had 3 trees fall behind my house that needed to be removed plus 2 dying pine trees that needed to come down and they did it all.

reviews.author: Donald Palumbo
reviews.text: Very pleased with JPX and the service performed was outstanding! I will recommend to anyone needing tree service. Keep up the good work!!

reviews.author: Gregory Hychko
reviews.text: Jared and the JPX team did an incredible job. They removed a number of large trees and shrubs. We were so pleased with their attention to detail. They treated our property as if it were their own. Our neighbor recommended Jared to us, and we will surely recommend JPX to others. Professional, fair and hardworking! Thank you JPX!!

reviews.author: Ann Marie Mims
reviews.text: We really appreciated the service JPX Tree Service provided. Great communication and work was efficient. Would definitely use them again and highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kenneth Bullwinkle
reviews.text: Workers did a great job protecting the property while cutting down 17 boarder trees at the back of my property. They ground the stumps smoothed out the dirt and removed all branches, stumps and debris.

reviews.author: Ashely Shorter
reviews.text: We had the opportunity to have JPX remove several trees from our front yard and trim others that were far reaching over our roofline. They were professional, highly skilled, and well priced. The fact that they were able to do a majority of the work from the boom truck, without ruining our grass, was a huge plus! Once the job was complete, they spent another hour+ simply cleaning up after themselves. I would 100% recommend JPX for anyone looking to have tree work done. Our yard looks amazing and is now safe for our littles. Thank you JPX!

reviews.author: John Morris
reviews.text: JPX has been amazing from start to finish. They sent out Matt to do the estimate, he actually came the day I called. He was professional and very knowledgeable. After speaking with Matt and his wealth of knowledge, my wife and I decided to go with JPX. The day of the job, the owner, Jared, walked through again what we wanted and was very easy to talk to. He walked us through the process, how they would use mats to protect our grass and even during the job they asked if wanted some extra bushes taken out. Overall I can’t express how amazing they were and the service they provided. For any new jobs we have, we will only deal with JPX.

reviews.author: Keith Epstein
reviews.text: Quick response, fare pricing, and excellent service. A+++ rating would recommend. Had a tree trimmed, Jared was very knowledgeable and made the process smooth.

reviews.author: Robinson Mechanical
reviews.text: They were amazing, they very thorough, and very nice and polite to work with we used them few times now. I definitely would recommend to anyone. Thank you for the awesome work you guys do for us. We will definitely use you again.

reviews.author: Dennis Fox
reviews.text: Great team. Jared and crew are professional and thorough. The team cleaned up when done cutting down trees Nd stump grinding. They are highly recommended.

reviews.author: Robert Moran
reviews.text: Everything was smooth and better than expected within the best price around. In and out without ever knowing they were on scene. Nothing left behind besides an empty space where a tree used to be! Thank you.

reviews.author: Chuck Conrad
reviews.text: We had a big silver maple trimmed today (11-6-25) and they did a great job you couldn't have asked for anything better. These people know what they are doing.

reviews.author: michael salisbury
reviews.text: These guys are the best! I’m a repeat customer, and I’ve been happy and satisfied every time. They are clean, polite, efficient, and extremely hard working. They did the work on time and on budget, with no unpleasant surprises. A professional company and a pleasure to work with them

reviews.author: Daniel Kov
reviews.text: JPX gave me the best quote out four different local tree companies. When it came time to do the work, they arrived on time, were professional and courteous. All around exceptional service; I highly recommend them and plan to use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Jessica Ascencio Curiel
reviews.text: The estimator was able to come out the next day that I called. There was some wait time on scheduling the service. Everyone is very professional from the estimator, scheduler and the crew including the owner. The owner is very knowledgeable and thoroughly explained everything to us. They removed tree stumps for us and cleaned up some logs and tree that was taking out. We have a lot of projects ahead of us and definitely will be using JPX again.

reviews.author: Jarred Levenson
reviews.text: Jared and his crew do incredible work. They took down 2 trees on my property. Highly skilled professionals, with the right equipment and experience to match. I would recommend them to everyone. They are the best in business!

reviews.author: Taylor Speirs
reviews.text: This company removed a ton of trees to open up my back yard. Their estimator was on time and walked me through the entire process. When it came time to schedule they showed up exactly when scheduled and went above and beyond my expectations. I would 100% recommend this company anyone looking to have their project taken care of!

reviews.author: Nathaniel S
reviews.text: JPX was great! It was an amazing price with great quality work! They finished the job in quick time and impressed me, definitely would recommend them!

reviews.author: Janice Simms
reviews.text: JPX was prompt with a reasonable cost. They removed my tree in a timely manner and cleaned up all of the debris. Would definitely call them again.

reviews.author: Lisa Cipolone
reviews.text: Great company!! Everything was thoroughly explained and they did a wonderful job. 6 hours of running over brush and taking down tree limbs and a bunch of bushes so we can have a lot more room on our property, was the best thing we ever did

reviews.author: Kathy Tully
reviews.text: JPX worked extremely professionally. Quoted, scheduled, and showed up when they promised. They did an expert job of taking down 4 trees and cleaned everything up. Couldn't ask for more. Thank you JPX. Kathy

reviews.author: Nate Berges
reviews.text: I’ve used JPX personally as well as recommended their services to friends and family. They’re on time, fairly priced, and complete every job in a clean and careful way. JPX is my land clearing choice now and into the future

reviews.author: Geo. Riess
reviews.text: Great service. Very Happy site was cleaned better than it was before. Crew very respectful. Could not be happier they took out 5 big oaks that were hard to get to. No damage to property. prices were very reasonable much lower than the guy I used prior. Highly recommend Thanks guys

reviews.author: Veterans Roofing
reviews.text: Called these guys out to assist with a roofing project where a tree fell onto a homeowners home, they came out with the equipment to get the job done safely and without causing any further damage! Well equipped company with great professionalism and will certainly refer them every time!

reviews.author: Mj Bock
reviews.text: I have never used this company....but yesterday I watched as Jared and his crew showed up at the Funny Farm in Mays Landing with a crane (a big one) in response to owner Laurie's need for help with Yogi the cow... Yogi was lying down in a muddy spot and couldn't get enough traction to stand back up on his own...The crew from JPX was knowledgeable, kind to Yogi and Laurie...if you live in South Jersey and ever need tree work please consider calling JPX tree services !!

reviews.author: Todd Connell
reviews.text: JPX took a very hard to reach tree down for me. They did an excellent job and when they left, it looked like it was never there. Great crew!! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Poultry Princess
reviews.text: I personally didnt use this company The Place I live in did and I must say thats some high tech tree cutting yall got going on. (I guess the old way is obsolete) But the crew of men working were very professional, they worked well as a team (from what I could see) they cleaned up the "tree mess" they absolutely worked like a well oiled machine ..kudos to the owner n crew.

reviews.author: jason kennedy
reviews.text: Awesome job, very affordable, did the job quick and safe, they cleaned up everything! Would use and recommend again!

reviews.author: Susan Montenegro
reviews.text: Very professional Company. Came in exactly the time they said. Friendly and did an amazing job removing a tree.

reviews.author: AJ Schenker
reviews.text: Had them remove 7 trees. Did it in 7ish hours and cleaned up everything. Will be recommending them to anyone i speak to!

reviews.author: Megan McCullough
reviews.text: Great service, removed my tree stump quickly reasonably priced and no mess left behind. Would use again

reviews.author: Judith Houde
reviews.text: Great company to deal with! Very friendly and reasonably priced- sweet girl answering the phone to answer any questions you might have-

reviews.author: Penni Pettit
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about JPX. Professional...Punctual..Reasonably Priced. I whole heartedly recommend them.

reviews.author: Laurissa Gendel
reviews.text: Wow! So impressed with the job from start to finish. Reliable, extremely professional, left property in immaculate condition. Would highly, highly recommend!

reviews.author: Maryann Petruzzi
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this company. Remember when you would hire someone to do a job, and it was perfect? That's them.

reviews.author: mike samsun
reviews.text: They removed four trees for me, Reasonable, professional, left property clean. I was very pleased and will use in future

reviews.author: Rene Ryan
reviews.text: Great job extremely professional and awesome job cleaning up. Much appreciation to the entire team!!!!!!

reviews.author: Peter West
reviews.text: What a hard and professional group. Everything went perfectly from the inquiring phone call, meeting with the sales rep, and the actual field employees and owner. I have already made recommendations to my friends. Thank you !

reviews.author: Edward Myers
reviews.text: JPX Tree Service provided top-notch communications, an immediate quote, a quick turnaround on the work, and excellent pricing. Their service provided one of the best contractor experiences that I've had over 28 years as a homeowner.

reviews.author: Lisa Schall
reviews.text: Excellent service from start to finish! The crew was professional, efficient, and took great care while removing our tree. They left the property spotless and exceeded our expectations. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jason Moceus
reviews.text: This is the first time I’ve used JPX. I had been seeing them doing a lot of work in my area and the finished results looked great. Then a friend recommended them to me and said they were very professional, efficient and had a very reasonable price. He was right on all accounts. All the workers didn’t waste any time. They took out 12 large trees for us and were all cleaned up before dinner time. The crew were all courteous and mindful of my property and their price couldn’t be beat. They will be my first call and my first recommendation for any tree or land clearing work.

reviews.author: T mccormack
reviews.text: I would give 10 stars. It’s not often you find a company that delivers what they promise. This team over delivered. Showed up professional, friendly, and organized. They set up and went to work. When I say this was a big job, that’s and understatement. 2 huge sycamore trees and three large stumps - one was basically landlocked- between my house and a retaining wall - only 1 other tree service would remove it. They were efficient and clean. 2 other neighbor asked for estimates and 3 other neighbors mentioned how clean there were with the removal. I’ve told all the people I know down here about them and it’s rare for me to recommend anyone.

reviews.author: Smaragda Ng
reviews.text: They did a great job and worked very hard to give me a beautiful backyard ! I waited years to get it done. So glad I did.

reviews.author: Connor Williams
reviews.text: I could not speak more highly to the quality of service I received. Their pricing is fantastic, they fit me into their schedule immediately, kept me updated on when my tree removal would be performed, and their crew had my tree removed, stump grinded, and yard cleaned up in less than 2 hours. They exceeded my expectations and went above and beyond by raking and leveling my yard where the stump was grinded down. I could not recommend them more.

reviews.author: Anthony Giunta
reviews.text: This company is excellent.By far the best price,super friendly,on time and went out of the way to do more than what was agreed upon.Because of the very dangerous condition of the trees on my property that threatened my house and my neighbors house,they fit me in right away.You will not find better,safer ,or more friendly people.
